description:
Robot 'Lightning' wins Beijing E-Town humanoid robot half-marathon

Honor's humanoid robot "Lightning" was crowned champion of the 2026 Beijing E‑Town Humanoid Robot Half‑Marathon on Sunday, finishing with a net time of 50 minutes and 26 seconds. The race kicked off at 7:30 in Beijing's Yizhuang District, also known as E-Town. It covers a total distance of 21.0975 kilometers, featuring two main categories of autonomous navigation and remote control. Robots from both categories competed on the same course, with results calculated using weighted coefficients of 1.0 and 1.2, respectively. Honor's Qitian Dasheng team took the first place, its Leiting Shandian team finished second in 50 minutes and 56 seconds, and the Xinghuo Liaoyuan team claimed third with 53 minutes and one second. All three podium finishers were competing under the autonomous navigation category.

CCTV VIA REUTERS
